decisions.reason: The font-identification and recommendation request does not change the required brand-colour specification; the colour-document opening failure is already represented separately as execution evidence.
Requesting identification of the logo lettering and complementary website fonts does not alter the selected logo's visual design or letterforms.
The font-guidance change does not modify the required logo file-format coverage; the same message's file-opening results are execution evidence already represented under this candidate.
The request for logo-font identification and complementary font recommendations does not change the required background-box or colour variants.
The new brand-font guidance details do not change the completed concept and revision process.
